package.name: acsdg_sensors_hw
package.description: High-fidelity sensor simulations for the ACSDG system: Echodyne EchoGuard radar, Dedrone RF-360 RF detector, and FLIR Boson+ 640 thermal camera. Every node carries a use_real_hardware parameter — setting it true switches from Gazebo simulation to the physical hardware interface without any downstream topic changes.
